chapters.title: The market and the three parties
chapters.caption: Rent risk, expressed as a fully backed token. One RENT can pay up to one USDC.

chapters.title: Price and fund the insurer position
chapters.caption: $100,000 modeled capital, 10% sold at $0.285: $2,850 premium and a known maximum net loss.

chapters.title: Size the renter cover and explore outcomes
chapters.caption: $60,000 annual rent implies 3,000 RENT for the five-point band. At a modeled $0.285, the cost is $855.

chapters.title: Buy and sell through the live local v4 pool
chapters.caption: Checkout separates spot price, simple conversion and executable pool quote. Buying 3,000 RENT moves the price.

chapters.title: Read the market price
chapters.caption: Price maps to a payout-equivalent growth level and index print. It is a priced capped payoff, not expected rent growth.

chapters.title: Authenticate the email and fix the payout
chapters.caption: Advance the LOCAL chain into September 2027. This future newsletter is signed by the test key, not the real publisher.

chapters.title: Burn RENT and receive escrowed USDC
chapters.caption: Redeem RENT burns the tokens and sends their fixed payout from the backing escrow, independently of Uniswap liquidity.

chapters.title: Close the insurer lifecycle
chapters.caption: After settlement, the insurer removes its pool inventory and redeems any RENT it still owns.

proof.scope: Local Anvil chain 31337; synthetic USDC; test-key signed emails. No mainnet settlement or user funds.
